name: An agent's stock line gets an eye-roll
judge: The agent ends a turn with a stock line of flattery and a promise to fix it. Boop shouldn't be impressed.
reasonable: An eye-roll, smirk, bored or skeptical look, mild amusement or annoyance. A reply, or nothing much. A teasing sign is fine.
unreasonable: Excited or proud, a big celebration, or treating the promise as finished work.

steps.message: You're absolutely right! I'll fix that.
